description: Toyota's Bridge specialist for the browser: opens Chrome on EG's desktop, navigates, reads a page back, lists a form's controls with their selectors, chooses in a dropdown, types in a field, presses a control
notes: Toyota's profile maps this name to adapters/bridge_specialist_runner.BridgeSpecialistRunner. The model only picks the operation and copies a selector; bridge_client/browser_plans.py builds the exact JSON prompt. Every change is read back and sent only after a yes. The same Bridge agent, worker adapter and Browser Control ADW that ChatGPT drives.
